standard_prerequisites.name: Evans's construction of *-generic structures from a class C_f with a predimension, and his characterization of forking by predimension
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at lines 1726-1733
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the theory T_n and the criterion that non-forking is detected by the equality d(A/C) = d(A/BC).

standard_prerequisites.name: The criteria on f for the generic theory to be well-defined and simple
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Verified inside the counted proof at lines 1732-1733
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the chosen f(x) = log(x)/log(3) satisfies 0 < f' < 1/x and f(3x) <= f(x)+1, so that T_n is supersimple.

core_obligations: Choose the data: a single k-ary relation with k = 3^{2n+1}, the predimension delta(A) = 2|A| - |R(A)|/k! (the factorial accounting for symmetry), and the function f(x) = log(x)/log(3) (proof lines 1725-1727).

Check the hypotheses: the criteria 0 < f'(x) < 1/x and f(3x) <= f(x) + 1 hold for all x >= 0, so the *-generic theory T_n is well-defined and simple, and by Evans's criterion it is supersimple of SU-rank at most 2 (proof lines 1732-1733).

Establish n-transitivity: distinct a_1, ..., a_n form an algebraically closed set, because an algebraic closure of size > n would have to have size at least k to carry an instance of R, which contradicts the bound on the predimension through f (proof line 1733).

Compute the rank: exhibit one instance of R on a k-element structure in C_f, so there is an algebraically closed set of size k; then d(a_1 / a_2...a_k) = 1 with a_1 not algebraic over the others while d(a_1 / empty) = 2, giving SU(p) = 2 and hence nmdeg(p) >= n by n-transitivity (proof line 1735).
proof_roadmap: Build the theory from a single relation with a factorial-corrected predimension and verify the simplicity criteria for the chosen f (proof lines 1725-1733).
Prove n-transitivity by bounding algebraic closures through the predimension, then force SU(p) = 2 with an explicit k-element instance of the relation (proof lines 1733-1735).
difficulty_reason: The fact asserts that for every n there is an omega-categorical supersimple theory with a type of non-minimality degree at least n (statement lines 1719-1723). The proof instantiates Evans's construction with a single k-ary relation, k = 3^{2n+1}, and the predimension delta(A) = 2|A| - |R(A)|/k!, verifying the two criteria on f(x) = log(x)/log(3) that make the generic theory simple (proof lines 1725-1733). The two steps that carry the content are then the n-transitivity computation, where an algebraic closure larger than n would have to be at least k in size and would violate the predimension bound through f, and the rank computation, which exhibits a k-element structure with exactly one instance of R to get SU(p) = 2 and hence the lower bound on the degree (proof lines 1733-1735). The construction is therefore explicit and the estimates are the substance. H2.
